mines.mine_notes: Open pit gold mine, Kayes region (includes Korali-Sud satellite pit, 15 km south). FY2025 (100% basis): 193,880 oz produced (attributable 80% = 155,104 oz); record Q4 production 57,191 oz. Cost of sales $2,137/oz, cash cost $2,030/oz, AISC $2,105/oz. Ore from Sadiola Main Pit Stage 5 and Sekekoto West (transitional/oxide, higher grades); new equipment mobilization and plant instrumentation upgrades. P&P reserves (100% basis): Sadiola 141,827 kt @ 1.49 g/t = 6,811 koz; Korali-Sud 2,933 kt @ 1.06 g/t = 100 koz.

Open pit gold mine (CDI Complex). FY2025 (100% basis): 100,678 oz produced (attributable 89.89% = 90,499 oz); Q4 33,279 oz. Cost of sales $1,786/oz, cash cost $1,436/oz, AISC $1,678/oz. P&P reserves (100% basis): 32,819 kt @ 1.23 g/t = 1,296 koz.

Open pit gold mine (CDI Complex). FY2025 (100% basis): 84,523 oz produced (attributable 85% = 71,845 oz); Q4 26,534 oz (higher throughput). Cost of sales $1,937/oz, cash cost $1,824/oz, AISC $2,269/oz. P&P reserves (100% basis): 5,608 kt @ 1.39 g/t = 250 koz.

Development-stage open pit gold project (construction). P&P reserves (100% basis): 63,950 kt @ 1.32 g/t = 2,706 koz. Government of Ethiopia entitled to 7% equity participation once mine enters commercial production. First production expected 2026-2027 per 2026 guidance (total company guidance includes Kurmuk contributions). No production in FY2025.

notes: FY2025 Q4/financial results used (year ended December 31, 2025; full annual MD&A figures per Q4 news release and audited financial statements). Production = attributable ounces (mine tables in release are 100% basis). FY2025: revenue $1,331.8M; gold sales 418,168 oz (attributable) at avg revenue $3,242/oz; mine-level cash cost $1,847/oz, AISC $2,037/oz (Q4 AISC $1,980/oz); net loss attributable $51.8M; cash ~$480M at YE2025. Total P&P reserves 247,137 kt @ 1.41 g/t = 11,164 koz (100% basis, eff. Dec 31, 2025; includes Sadiola 6,811 koz, Korali-Sud 100 koz, Kurmuk 2,706 koz, Bonikro 1,296 koz, Agbaou 250 koz).
